reviewerDisclosure: This reviewer authored the engine change a74d478 and its engine regressions; engine review is not independent. AI/UI integration and their failure seams were reviewed independently. This reviewer also ran the retained functional matrix, so that evidence is verification, not a separate independent test run.
verdict: PASS read-only source audit; no actionable defect found in reviewed scope

failureCases.failureCase: Minimum World target overlaps occupied enemy sea and snaps to another legal destination
failureCases.evidence: BoardDropTargetResolver rejects actual occupied polygon before nearest-target selection; ordinary and World hosted/native regression assertions inspect legal alternatives and unchanged proposal/state.

failureCases.failureCase: Blockade polygon prevents selecting an owned ship in a captured mixed stack
failureCases.evidence: Polygon veto applies to tile-target resolver only. Ship selection uses separate NavalShipLayer/Fleet and legalShips derived from complete engine moves; engine seeds mixed origin and blocks neighbor entry only.

failureCases.failureCase: Owner tint, outlines or destinations still use pre-capture state
failureCases.evidence: Presentation recomputes occupancy from live state using stable owner/id ordering. Coordinator invalidates/reconciles candidates on committed move count/actor change; capture intentionally has no blockade tile veto.

failureCases.failureCase: AI prices a blocked corridor as a two-hex win or funds an inaccessible island
failureCases.evidence: Both tier distance searches filter shared engine predicate; reachableColonySites gates funding; immediate sailing uses engine canonical route. Decision caches are newly constructed per immutable observation.

failureCases.failureCase: Reverse diagnostic search crosses a blocked mixed origin and reports false progress
failureCases.evidence: Reverse graph includes origin for departure-distance comparison but stops expansion when that origin is rival-held. Other blocked coordinates are excluded.

failureCases.failureCase: Enemy occupancy leaks concealed terrain into legality, art or bot evaluation
failureCases.evidence: Ships/owners are existing public observation fields. Engine sea routes require revealed sea; UI uses public occupancy and visible board; launch reason calls engine candidate partition. AI uses masked observation tile index.

failureCases.failureCase: Hull limit or missing resources is incorrectly labeled as a blockade
failureCases.evidence: BuildActionPresentation phase/supply/missing-cost reasons precede location reason. blockadedLaunchSites shares owned/charted coastal and hull-stock candidates with launchSites.

failureCases.failureCase: Friendly sharing, zero-step defenders or remaining third-party blocker handled differently between layers
failureCases.evidence: Single owner-inequality predicate ignores steps; all engine/UI/AI filters delegate it. Existing authored engine cases cover capture, friendly/transit, zero steps and third-party residual blocks.

failureCases.failureCase: Naval v1-v3 checkpoint/replay or missing-version behavior silently adopts v4
failureCases.evidence: All new occupancy/AI bonuses/funding/UI decoration are gated by saved Naval version>=4. Missing decode remains v1. Engine version3/schema6/map1 remain unchanged; rulebook reads saved version.

failureCases.failureCase: New dictionary/set traversal changes deterministic gameplay or presentation choice
failureCases.evidence: Engine BFS expands sorted neighbors and exposes sorted destinations; policy loops use fixed direction order. UI mixed-owner tint uses sorted owner/id and rendering sorted coordinates. Fresh six-process full result+trace comparisons remain bound to all112 package inputs.

failureCases.failureCase: DEBUG fixture uses hidden world geography as production policy input
failureCases.evidence: NavalBlockadeQAFixture preparation is inside #if DEBUG and explicitly creates a replacement generated-world baseline; future native actions still use production rules and conserved supply. Historical intentional mixed-owner sail-in art fixture remains Naval v3 instead of weakening v4.

runtimeLimitations: No native or build operations executed for this audit. The maritime Dynamic Type cap and rendered-text OCR regression require root runtime verification; source review does not establish final UI pixels or delivery readiness.
Full gate, Release signing/upload/Apple availability are outside this audit.
